Before: orange juice (~200 ml, ~90 kcal), a second glass of pale juice (apple or pear, ~150 ml, ~70 kcal), a fruit bowl (watermelon, cantaloupe, strawberries, ~200 g, ~65 kcal), and a grilled sandwich (2 slices of bread with a little cheese/tomato, ~130 g, ~300 kcal).

After: the orange juice is almost gone (~10 ml left). The pale juice is nearly full, with maybe 10% drunk. The bowl still has 2-3 pieces of cantaloupe (~40 g), so about 160 g of fruit was eaten. The sandwich is mostly eaten, with a crust piece left (~15 g) plus tomato slices (~25 g) that were removed and left. So the sandwich eaten is about 130 - 15 = 115 g, though some of that was tomato. Counting the sandwich as bread and cheese, roughly 90 g eaten.

Energy eaten:
- Orange juice: about 85 kcal (~190 g)
- Pale juice: about 7 kcal (~15 g)
- Fruit: about 52 kcal (160 g)
- Sandwich: about 230 kcal (90 g)

Total is about 374 kcal. Mass is 190 + 15 + 160 + 90 = 455 g.
